    Lumina Continent¶

    A continent in central Ge'or, bordered by the Kutten Sea to the north (separating it from Mia island), the Luminous Ocean to the northeast, the Greater Ocean to the east, and the Marti Sea to the south. Northwest sits Kutten and beyond it the Demon Continent; to the southwest sit Marti Continent and Xeti across Beast's Bay.

    Overview¶

    The continent takes its name from the Lumina Kingdom, once a powerful empire in the distant past. Over millennia, the original name evolved linguistically until it converged on the modern word "Lumina."

    Nations¶

    • Maoma Tribe — beastmen tribe, southeast of Mia across the Kutten Sea
    • Lumina Kingdom — namesake kingdom, commerce with Erisdar, multi-racial
    • Vennerian Goishi — Vennerian Trade Republic commercial outpost with cities
    • Cammao Kingdom — demonfolk minority + Eastern Beastmen traders
    • Gigas Tribe — strongest beastmen, warmongers, dominant power
    • Lake Kingdom — Lesser Catmen, main player on Marti Sea side
    • Lumina Republic — human settler republic, multi-ethnic
    • New Eris — large Vennerian colony, connected to Marti Sea
    • Tree Tribe — Treemen living in tree-houses
    • Great Cattos — Lesser Catmen country around a lake
    • Vennerian Aelefer Channel — Vennerian channel connecting to Beast's Bay
    • Anos Lumina Outpost — Anos Plutocracy outpost

    Offshore¶

    • Cattos — island nation of Erisdarian Catmen and Lesser Catmen
    • Anos Cattos — smaller Anos outpost island northeast of Cattos
